title: Inspection packages
subtitle: Versioned inspection forms, their sections, items and response rules

toolbar.search: Search package code, title or scope

register.caption: Packages you can see
register.immutable: Published version — the definition and label are locked. To change this package, create a new draft.
register.emptyBody: Adjust the search or choose another state.
register.noneBodyWriter: No packages exist yet. Create the first one to begin.

workbench.notFoundTitle: That package is no longer available
workbench.notFoundBody: It may have been removed since this link was made. Return to the register to choose another.
workbench.noVersionTitle: This package has no versions yet
workbench.noVersionBody: Create the first version to open the designer, the field preview and publish impact.
workbench.immutableTitle: This version is published and locked
workbench.immutableBody: Its definition and label cannot change. Create a new draft version to make changes.
workbench.readOnlyBody: You can read the structure through the field preview. Saving and publishing need the compliance or form administrator role.
workbench.deactivateHint: Deactivation ends the effective window of this version. Work already pinned to it keeps running on the version it downloaded.

templates.hint: Official templates, kept in versions, that action forms and penalty lists can use.

governance.heading: Governance on this surface
governance.validate: Publishing revalidates sections, items, response mappings, evidence and action-form dependencies.
governance.maker: Maker-checker approval is enforced by the publish actions and database guards.
governance.runtime: Execution consumes only the locked package version pinned to the visit.
governance.immutable: A package used by a published visit cannot have its structure edited. Changes create a new draft, and past inspections stay pinned to their original version.

notices.readOnlyBody: You can view versions, previews and publish impact. Creating, saving or publishing needs the compliance or form administrator role.
notices.permissionUnknownTitle: Write permissions could not be checked
notices.permissionUnknownBody: Every edit control is hidden until your role can be read again. Reload to try again.
notices.itemBankBody: Versions and publish impact still show. Editing and field preview are paused. We could not read the item data they need.
notices.templatesBody: Packages still show. Template references cannot be added or changed until it can be read again.

denied.title: Inspection packages are restricted
denied.body: No package data has been loaded. This screen requires a configuration role, so nothing here is shown rather than hidden.

error.title: The package library could not be loaded
error.body: No package, version or item definition was changed. Retry, or quote the reference below to support.
error.libraryTitle: The package library could not be read
error.libraryBody: Nothing was changed. Reload the page to try again.
